props.html:
Concrete colour sealing in Melbourne

When cleaning has done all it can

Some slabs come up beautifully. Some come up clean and still look tired: patchy where repairs were made, lighter where an old stain was treated, faded unevenly by twenty years of sun. Colour sealing puts a pigmented coat across the whole surface so it reads as one thing again, and seals it in the same pass.

  • Evens out patchy and faded concrete
  • Seals at the same time
  • A fraction of the cost of replacing a slab
Get A Quote 0400 638 010
  1. Home

What it is for

Concrete that is clean but not uniform. Cleaning removes what is on a surface. It cannot remove a patch where the slab was cut and repaired, a lighter area where a stain was successfully treated, or twenty years of uneven UV fading. Those are differences in the concrete rather than on it.

A colour seal is a pigmented topical coating applied across the whole slab. Because it covers everything equally, the variations underneath stop reading as variations. It also seals, so the surface stops absorbing. It is the honest middle option between accepting a tired driveway and paying a concreter to replace one.

The three options

Honestly compared

What each costs you and what you actually get.
  What it does Rough cost Service life
Clean and seal clear Removes what is on the surface, protects it, changes nothing underneath Lowest Five to seven years penetrating, three to five topical
Colour seal Covers variation, recolours, seals. The slab reads as one surface Middle Three to five years, then a recoat
Resurfacing A new cementitious wear layer over the existing slab Higher Long, but it is a different trade and a bigger disruption
Replacement Break out and repour. The only answer where the slab has structurally failed Highest by far Decades

Swipe for the rest of the columns

Worth knowing before you commit

Four honest points

It is a coating, so it wears

Three to five years on a driveway and then a recoat, which is cheaper than the first application because the preparation is a wash. It is maintenance rather than a permanent change.

It will not save a failing slab

Spalling, delamination or crazing is concrete coming apart. A coating over it fails with it, and we will say so rather than taking the job.

Colour choice is semi permanent

Changing your mind afterwards means stripping the coat, which is a real job. We do a test area so you can look at the colour dry, outside, over a day.

Grip matters on a coloured driveway

Pigmented topical coatings are films, so on a slope or near a pool it goes down with an anti slip additive in the coat as standard.

Questions

Asked about recolouring concrete

Is it paint?

No, and the distinction matters. Paint sits on the surface as a decorative film. A colour seal is a sealer carrying pigment, formulated to bond to concrete and to be driven on, and it does the protective job as well as the cosmetic one.

Driveway paint from a hardware store is not the same product and does not last the same way.

Will it hide my oil stain?

Usually yes, and it is one of the main reasons people choose it. A deep old oil stain that cannot be fully removed disappears under an even pigmented coat.

The stain still has to be treated first, as far as it will go, because a heavily contaminated area can stop the coating bonding. Oil stain removal comes first.

How long does it last?

Three to five years on a residential driveway, less under heavy traffic or a lot of turning. The wheel tracks dull first, which is the visual cue that a recoat is due.

Recoating is considerably cheaper than the first application, because the preparation is a wash rather than a full clean and treat.

Can I choose any colour?

Within a standard range, and the honest advice is to stay close to what concrete naturally looks like. Charcoals, sandstones and warm greys read as a finished surface. Strong or unusual colours read as paint and date quickly.

We do a test area so you can look at it dry, outside, at different times of day.

What about the rest of the property?

Worth thinking about, because a colour sealed driveway next to a bare concrete path draws attention to the path. Doing the connected hard surfaces together usually looks better and costs less per square metre.

Does it have to be cleaned first?

Thoroughly, and then dried completely. A coloured coating over trapped moisture goes cloudy, and over a dirty surface it does not bond. It is the same sequence as any topical sealer: clean, dry for two or three clear days, then coat.
